svg.title: JDBC Lettuce Cache Flow
svg.desc: Sequence diagram rebuilt from exposed-jdbc-lettuce README, sync/suspend repository source, loader/writer source, and Lettuce repository tests.
svg.text: Reads check optional suspend NearCache, then Redis, then JDBC; writes follow Lettuce write mode and Exposed JDBC writer policy.

g.id: a t c a t c a l l

a t c a t c

g.text: NearCache steps apply to the suspend repository path; the blocking path reads and writes through the LettuceLoadedMap directly.
Write-through waits for the JDBC writer, write-behind queues the DB flush, and repository delete invokes writer delete.
